channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3) (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Hoedown Yard 3 was trimmed where it overlapped a neighbouring Assessor lot.
item.description: Hoedown Yard 3 was trimmed where it overlapped a neighbouring Assessor lot. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 4110013.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): The Hoedown Yard is no longer called 'former' or 'that once occupied this area': the D4D describes it as PG&E-owned land that HDY3 is part of, outside Brookfield's 28-acre site, and the map notes give the Assessor lots the D4D names and drop an uncited brochure. Resolution 17-45 is described as zoning the whole Special Use District, the Oct 24, 2017 Board hearing is described as scheduled rather than held, and the Item 11A milestone is dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report. Source credits no longer say 'adopted 2017' or name OEWD as publisher.
item.description: The Hoedown Yard is no longer called 'former' or 'that once occupied this area': the D4D describes it as PG&E-owned land that HDY3 is part of, outside Brookfield's 28-acre site, and the map notes give the Assessor lots the D4D names and drop an uncited brochure. Resolution 17-45 is described as zoning the whole Special Use District, the Oct 24, 2017 Board hearing is described as scheduled rather than held, and the Item 11A milestone is dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report. Source credits no longer say 'adopted 2017' or name OEWD as publisher. Source: Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 SUD Design for Development, updated 2022-04-26 (https://www.sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): The 2017 projection of $736,000 in annual Community Facilities District special taxes from Parcel K North and the Hoedown Yard, previously repeated on this record, is now listed once in the shared site-wide cost list for Pier 70, and this record points to it.
item.description: The 2017 projection of $736,000 in annual Community Facilities District special taxes from Parcel K North and the Hoedown Yard, previously repeated on this record, is now listed once in the shared site-wide cost list for Pier 70, and this record points to it. Source: Port of San Francisco, Item 9B: Pier 70 Mixed-Use Project approvals, 2017-09-22, p.16 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026) says the Hoedown Yard IRFD tax increment, one of three gap-funding sources for the affordable sites, is 'currently unavailable as market-rate development has yet to occur' (Aug 7, 2026)
item.description: Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026) says the Hoedown Yard IRFD tax increment, one of three gap-funding sources for the affordable sites, is 'currently unavailable as market-rate development has yet to occur' (Aug 7, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Board of Supervisors resolution of intention (File 170880) calls a public hearing for October 24, 2017 on formation of Infrastructure and Revitalization Financing District No. 2 (Hoedown Yard); the Port's Sept 2017 packet only schedules the hearing, and whether it was held that day was not confirmed (Oct 24, 2017)
item.description: Board of Supervisors resolution of intention (File 170880) calls a public hearing for October 24, 2017 on formation of Infrastructure and Revitalization Financing District No. 2 (Hoedown Yard); the Port's Sept 2017 packet only schedules the hearing, and whether it was held that day was not confirmed (Oct 24, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Port Commission consents to zoning the Hoedown Yard (Assessor's Blocks 4120/002 and 4711/008A per the memo) into the Pier 70 Special Use District (Resolution 17-45) and recommends the IRFD (17-49) (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: Port Commission consents to zoning the Hoedown Yard (Assessor's Blocks 4120/002 and 4711/008A per the memo) into the Pier 70 Special Use District (Resolution 17-45) and recommends the IRFD (17-49) (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.

item.title: Planned · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Port Commission Resolution 17-45 consents to zoning amendments establishing the Pier 70 Special Use District over the 28-Acre Site, the 20th & Illinois Street Parcel and the PG&E-owned Hoedown Yard, and approves the Design for Development, bringing the Hoedown Yard into the SUD land-use and height framework as a future development parcel; the Hoedown Yard is not part of FC Pier 70's 28-Acre Project DDA (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: Port Commission Resolution 17-45 consents to zoning amendments establishing the Pier 70 Special Use District over the 28-Acre Site, the 20th & Illinois Street Parcel and the PG&E-owned Hoedown Yard, and approves the Design for Development, bringing the Hoedown Yard into the SUD land-use and height framework as a future development parcel; the Hoedown Yard is not part of FC Pier 70's 28-Acre Project DDA (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Capital Planning Committee briefed on the resolutions of intent to form the Hoedown Yard IRFD and issue bonds (Sep 11, 2017)
item.description: Capital Planning Committee briefed on the resolutions of intent to form the Hoedown Yard IRFD and issue bonds (Sep 11, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco (presentation to the Capital Planning Committee), 2017-09-11.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Hoedown Yard 3 (HDY3): Mayor Lee and Supervisor Cohen introduce resolutions of intention to form Infrastructure and Revitalization Financing District No. 2 (Hoedown Yard) to finance affordable housing within Pier 70 and Parcel K South (Jul 25, 2017)
item.description: Mayor Lee and Supervisor Cohen introduce resolutions of intention to form Infrastructure and Revitalization Financing District No. 2 (Hoedown Yard) to finance affordable housing within Pier 70 and Parcel K South (Jul 25, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.
